data.name: IamSignUpSummary
data.value: Sign up

data.name: IamSignUpDescription
data.value: Registers a Caregiver or FamilyMember account. The role defaults to Caregiver; Admin is rejected with 400. The password is stored as a BCrypt hash and is never returned. Public endpoint.

data.name: IamSignInSummary
data.value: Sign in

data.name: IamSignInDescription
data.value: Authenticates a user and returns a JWT access token (15 minutes at most). Wrong credentials and inactive accounts return 401. Public endpoint.

data.name: IamGetUsersSummary
data.value: Look up users by email, or list all users

data.name: IamGetUsersDescription
data.value: With ?email= it is a public lookup that returns an array with zero or one element containing only id and email (compatibility compromise with the frontend). Without email it requires a Bearer token with the Admin role and returns the full users.

data.name: IamGetUserByIdDescription

data.name: IamCreateUserSummary
data.value: Create a user (Admin)

data.name: IamCreateUserDescription
data.value: Creates a user with any role, including Admin. Only for administrators.

data.name: IamUpdateUserSummary
data.value: Update a user

data.name: IamUpdateUserDescription
data.value: Replaces the email, role, status and, optionally, the password of a user. Administrators can update any user; other users only themselves. Nobody can change their own role or status.

data.name: IamDeactivateUserSummary
data.value: Deactivate a user (Admin)

data.name: IamDeactivateUserDescription
data.value: Logical delete: the status becomes Inactive and the row is kept. The user can no longer sign in, but tokens already issued stay valid until they expire (15 minutes at most). An administrator cannot deactivate themselves.

data.name: IamUserDeactivatedResponse

data.name: IamCannotDeactivateSelfResponse
data.value: An administrator cannot deactivate their own account.

data.name: ProfilesGetCaregiverProfilesSummary
data.value: Get caregiver profiles

data.name: ProfilesGetCaregiverProfilesDescription
data.value: With ?userId=, returns an array with the caregiver profile of that user (zero or one element); only the user themselves or an administrator. Without filters, lists every profile (administrators only).

data.name: ProfilesGetCaregiverProfileByIdSummary
data.value: Get a caregiver profile

data.name: ProfilesGetCaregiverProfileByIdDescription
data.value: The owner, administrators and family members with an active access to an older adult in the charge of this caregiver can read it.

data.name: ProfilesCreateCaregiverProfileSummary
data.value: Create a caregiver profile

data.name: ProfilesCreateCaregiverProfileDescription
data.value: A user with the Caregiver role creates only their own profile (userId = token sub); administrators can create it for any existing user. One profile per user (409).

data.name: ProfilesUpdateCaregiverProfileSummary
data.value: Update a caregiver profile

data.name: ProfilesUpdateCaregiverProfileDescription
data.value: Replaces the whole profile. Only the owner or an administrator; userId cannot change (409).

data.name: ProfilesGetFamilyMemberProfilesSummary
data.value: Get family member profiles

data.name: ProfilesGetFamilyMemberProfilesDescription
data.value: ?id=1&id=2 returns the profiles the requester can read (their own, and for caregivers the ones linked to their older adults); the others are left out. ?userId= returns zero or one profile of the user themselves. Without filters, administrators only.

data.name: ProfilesGetFamilyMemberProfileByIdSummary
data.value: Get a family member profile

data.name: ProfilesGetFamilyMemberProfileByIdDescription
data.value: The owner, administrators and caregivers with an older adult linked to this family member can read it.

data.name: ProfilesCreateFamilyMemberProfileSummary
data.value: Create a family member profile

data.name: ProfilesCreateFamilyMemberProfileDescription
data.value: A user with the FamilyMember role creates only their own profile, and only when their email has a pending, unexpired invitation (403 otherwise). One profile per user (409).

data.name: ProfilesUpdateFamilyMemberProfileSummary
data.value: Update a family member profile

data.name: ProfilesUpdateFamilyMemberProfileDescription
data.value: Replaces the whole profile. Only the owner or an administrator; userId cannot change (409).

data.name: ProfilesGetOlderAdultsSummary
data.value: Get older adults

data.name: ProfilesGetOlderAdultsDescription
data.value: ?id=1&id=2 returns the older adults the requester can read (in their charge or with an active family access); the others are left out. ?caregiverId= returns the older adults of the requester's own caregiver profile (403 otherwise). Without filters, administrators only.

data.name: ProfilesGetOlderAdultByIdSummary
data.value: Get an older adult

data.name: ProfilesGetOlderAdultByIdDescription
data.value: The caregiver in charge, administrators and family members with an active access can read it.

data.name: ProfilesCreateOlderAdultSummary
data.value: Register an older adult

data.name: ProfilesCreateOlderAdultDescription
data.value: caregiverId must be the requester's own caregiver profile. birthDate (yyyy-MM-dd) cannot be later than today in Peru. A missing status means Active.

data.name: ProfilesUpdateOlderAdultSummary
data.value: Update an older adult

data.name: ProfilesUpdateOlderAdultDescription
data.value: Replaces the whole older adult. Only the caregiver in charge; status is required (use Archived to end the follow-up) and caregiverId cannot change (409).

data.name: ProfilesGetFamilyAccessesSummary
data.value: Look up an invitation or list family accesses

data.name: ProfilesGetFamilyAccessesDescription
data.value: ?invitationCode= is public: it returns the invitation (id, invitedEmail, invitationCode, relationship, status, expiresAt) only when it is pending and not expired, otherwise []. With a token: ?olderAdultId= (caregiver in charge), ?familyMemberId= (own profile) or no filter (administrators); status filters all of them.

data.name: ProfilesGetFamilyAccessByIdSummary
data.value: Get a family access

data.name: ProfilesGetFamilyAccessByIdDescription
data.value: The caregiver in charge, the linked family member and administrators can read it.

data.name: ProfilesCreateFamilyAccessSummary
data.value: Invite a family member

data.name: ProfilesCreateFamilyAccessDescription
data.value: Only the caregiver in charge. The server generates a random code (VITA- + 8 characters), status Pending and an expiration of 7 days, ignoring those fields in the body. 409 when the email already has a pending or active access.

data.name: ProfilesUpdateFamilyAccessSummary
data.value: Accept, revoke or update a family access

data.name: ProfilesUpdateFamilyAccessDescription
data.value: Pending → Active: the invited person (token email) with their own familyMemberId, before expiresAt. → Revoked: the caregiver in charge. Same status: only relationship changes. Revoked is final (409). Only status, familyMemberId and relationship are read.

data.name: IamGetCurrentUserSummary
data.value: Get the signed-in user

data.name: IamGetCurrentUserDescription
data.value: Returns the user of the Bearer token, read again from the database. 401 when the token is missing, invalid or expired, or when the user no longer exists or is inactive.

data.name: IamRefreshTokenSummary
data.value: Refresh the access token

data.name: IamRefreshTokenDescription
data.value: No body. Requires a valid Bearer token, checks again that the user exists and is active, and returns a new token with the same shape as the sign-in. The new token lasts the configured minutes (15 at most).

data.name: MonitoringGetDailyReportsSummary
data.value: Get daily reports

data.name: MonitoringGetDailyReportsDescription
data.value: ?olderAdultId= returns the reports of that older adult (caregiver in charge, family member with an active access or administrator; 403 otherwise). Without filters, administrators only.

data.name: MonitoringGetDailyReportByIdSummary
data.value: Get a daily report

data.name: MonitoringGetDailyReportByIdDescription
data.value: 404 when it does not exist; 403 when the requester cannot read its older adult.

data.name: MonitoringCreateDailyReportSummary
data.value: Record a daily report

data.name: MonitoringCreateDailyReportDescription
data.value: Only the caregiver in charge. recordedByUserId is the token user. reportDate is a UTC instant and cannot be in the future.

data.name: MonitoringUpdateDailyReportSummary
data.value: Update a daily report

data.name: MonitoringUpdateDailyReportDescription
data.value: Replaces the report. Only the caregiver in charge; olderAdultId cannot change (409); the original author is kept.

data.name: MonitoringGetVitalSignsSummary
data.value: Get vital signs

data.name: MonitoringGetVitalSignsDescription
data.value: ?olderAdultId= returns the measurements of that older adult (caregiver in charge, family member with an active access or administrator; 403 otherwise). Without filters, administrators only.

data.name: MonitoringGetVitalSignByIdSummary
data.value: Get a vital sign

data.name: MonitoringGetVitalSignByIdDescription
data.value: 404 when it does not exist; 403 when the requester cannot read its older adult.

data.name: MonitoringCreateVitalSignSummary
data.value: Record a vital sign

data.name: MonitoringCreateVitalSignDescription
data.value: Only the caregiver in charge. The value must be inside the range of its type; blood pressure needs secondaryValue lower than value. The unit is derived from the type. measuredAt cannot be in the future.

data.name: MonitoringUpdateVitalSignSummary
data.value: Correct a vital sign

data.name: MonitoringUpdateVitalSignDescription
data.value: Replaces the measurement. Only the caregiver in charge; olderAdultId cannot change (409).

data.name: MonitoringGetMedicationsSummary
data.value: Get medications

data.name: MonitoringGetMedicationsDescription
data.value: ?olderAdultId= returns the medications of that older adult (caregiver in charge, family member with an active access or administrator; 403 otherwise). Without filters, administrators only. ?active= filters by the active flag.

data.name: MonitoringGetMedicationByIdSummary
data.value: Get a medication

data.name: MonitoringGetMedicationByIdDescription
data.value: 404 when it does not exist; 403 when the requester cannot read its older adult.

data.name: MonitoringCreateMedicationSummary
data.value: Register a medication

data.name: MonitoringCreateMedicationDescription
data.value: Only the caregiver in charge. scheduleTimes has 1 to 12 HH:mm times, stored sorted and without duplicates. active defaults to true.

data.name: MonitoringUpdateMedicationSummary
data.value: Update or deactivate a medication

data.name: MonitoringUpdateMedicationDescription
data.value: Replaces the medication; send active: false to deactivate it (there is no delete). Only the caregiver in charge; olderAdultId cannot change (409).
